institution: Universitat Internacional Valenciana / Universidad Internacional de Valencia (VIU) — 100% online, Valencia (Planeta Formación y Universidades)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Big Data y Ciencia de Datos
official_status: máster universitario (OFICIAL) — RUCT 4317654, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E.'
spring_intake: YES — VERIFIED from VIU's own published cohort calendar PDF
start_date_verbatim: PDF title block: «Máster Universitario en Big Data y Ciencia de Datos — ABRIL 2026/27»; the teaching grid's first taught week is «Abril 2026 … 20 21 22 23 24 25 26» (Tutoría Colectiva a cargo del Director/a de Título then Fundamentos de la Tecnología Big Data). A separate first page «ABRIL 2026/27 - Complementos Formativos» runs Febrero–Julio 2026. Programme page hero for the CURRENT open cohort reads «Inicio Oct. 2026».
start_month: April (second annual cohort) — the April 2026/27 cohort began 20 April 2026; complementos formativos for it began February 2026
intakes_per_year: 2 — October and April. VIU's own downloads panel on the programme page lists four calendar PDFs under the headings «Convocatoria octubre 26/27», «Convocatoria abril 26/27», «Convocatoria octubre 25/26», «Convocatoria abril 25/26», i.e. an October and an April cohort in each of the last two academic years.
other_intakes: October (e.g. «Convocatoria octubre 26/27», file 10_26 MU_ Big Data.pdf). Programme page currently advertises «Oct. 2026».
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: NOT FOUND — VIU publishes no dated application/enrolment close for the April convocatoria anywhere on the programme page, the calendar PDFs or the calendario académico index. The April 2026/27 calendar's only procedural date markers are «Inicio de los Complementos Formativos» (February 2026) and a «Período de evaluación en 1ª Convocatoria (CF) para matrículas tardías» (June 2026), which implies late enrolment is accepted after the cohort opens but fixes no closing date. Admission is adviser-led and rolling («PLAZAS LIMITADAS»).
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND — no price printed on the programme page; page shows only «Apertura de expediente gratuita y hasta un 33% de descuento» and «Financiación a 36 meses sin intereses»
evidence_verbatim: Calendar PDF header: «Máster Universitario en Big Data y Ciencia de Datos | ABRIL 2026/27». Footer: «Nota: El calendario podrá sufrir variaciones puntuales acorde las necesidades de ordenación académica. Fecha última de actualización 15 de abril de 2026.» Downloads modal headings: «Convocatoria octubre 26/27» / «Convocatoria abril 26/27» / «Convocatoria octubre 25/26» / «Convocatoria abril 25/26».
notes: CONFIRMS the sweep's prior report that VIU runs October and April. The April cohort is a REAL second cohort with its own full teaching calendar (own complementos-formativos block, own exam convocatorias, own TFM/prácticas grid running to May 2027), not a module-entry point. 60 ECTS, one year. For a candidate targeting Sept 2027, the relevant instance is the April 2027 cohort ('Convocatoria abril 27/28'), whose calendar PDF is not yet published — only 25/26 and 26/27 are up. Note the file naming: the April PDF is 04_26...(15-4-26).pdf, i.e. the 26/27 April cohort STARTED April 2026, so VIU labels a cohort by the academic year it spans, not by the calendar year of the label. Spring deadline remains the one open gap — needs a human to ask VIU admissions. Fetched with a browser User-Agent via curl; WebFetch on the older URL slug /master-big-data-ciencia-datos returns 404 (slug changed to /master-universitario-big-data-data-science).
